name: flow
description: Khai's working loop as a plugin — route the task, explore or design before code, write a phased plan with the loop prompt that executes it, work one slice at a time, look at the running app on desktop and mobile, then hand off.

fog_skill.title: Foggy-route skill
fog_skill.description: Skill invoked on route 3, when something material is still undecided. Defaults to grill-me, which interviews a plan until every branch resolves. Use mattpocock-skills:wayfinder instead when the work spans more sessions than one agent can hold and you want decision tickets on your tracker.
